preconditions.description: The number of sets n must be between 1 and 10,000.
The rank k must be between 1 and 100.

postconditions.description: The first line of output must be the minimal possible m.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(map(int, line.split()))) == 4 for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: Each of the next n lines must contain exactly four distinct integers.

postconditions.expression: all(all(gcd(int(a), int(b)) == k for a in set(map(int, line.split())) for b in set(map(int, line.split())) if a != b) for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: For each set, the gcd of any two distinct elements must equal k.
